entities.name: Drosophila Golgin-84
observations: Exact sequence match to the analyzed 516-residue protein; reviewed UniProt accession Q8SZ63.
Golgin-84 is a single-pass type IV Golgi membrane protein with a cytoplasmic N-terminal region and a C-terminal transmembrane anchor.
Curated function: contributes to Golgi structure and intra-Golgi transport.
Reference topology places residues 1–492 in the cytoplasm, residues 493–513 in a helical transmembrane region, and residues 514–516 in the lumen.
Reference features include a low-complexity/disordered region around residues 28–80 and a coiled-coil region around residues 108–423.

source_tools.relevance: Exact sequence match, curated function, topology, localization, and reference features

entities.name: Golgin_A5 domain
observations: Pfam Golgin_A5 domain detected at positions 211–515 with i-Evalue 1.5e-54.

entities.name: Golgi apparatus membrane
observations: Curated localization includes Golgi apparatus membrane, cis-Golgi network membrane, and Golgi cisternae.

entities.name: Intra-Golgi vesicle transport
observations: Curated annotations include Golgi organization, Golgi vesicle transport, intra-Golgi vesicle-mediated transport, and retrograde transport within the Golgi.

observations.name: Analyzed 516-residue protein
observations: Length 516 aa; calculated molecular weight 58,679 Da; theoretical pI 6.40; predicted net charge at pH 7 approximately -3.24; GRAVY -0.747.

The sequence contains an N-terminal low-complexity serine-rich region, an extended acidic/basic helical coiled-coil-rich region, and a strongly hydrophobic C-terminal segment consistent with a membrane anchor.
Curated annotations support protein-macromolecule adaptor activity, small GTPase binding, and vesicle membrane tethering activity.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence-derived properties and curated functional annotations
